profile.description: Almunajem Foods Company, together with its subsidiary, engages in the wholesale and retail trade of fruits, vegetables, cold and frozen poultry and meat, bottled, and food stuff in Saudi Arabia. The company provides poultry and meat; cheese, butter, cream, and evaporated milk; potato, okra, green beans, frozen peas, molokheya, spinach, mixed vegetables, corn, broccoli, and canned vegetables; green, black, greek, and kalamata olives, as well as oil; avocado, acai, mango, pomegranate, guava, strawberry, berries, cherries, and cocktails; rice, cooking oil, thyme, ketchup, mayonnaise, hot sauce, tomato paste, broad beans, and tahina; seafood, shrimp, and fish FPP; chicken, meat, vegetarian, and pizza ready meals; and puff pastry, paratha, samosa, spring roll, kunafa, and baklava products. It also offers logistical services, including storage and transportation services. The company sells its products under the Dari, DOUX, COOPOLIVA, LambWeston, President, Asmak, Montana, Marietta, Fletcher, Silver Fern Farms, Valbreso, Moralejo Selección, and Villa Germania brands through direct-to-retail distribution, food services, wholesale, and online sales platforms. The company was founded in 1950 and is headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Almunajem Foods Company operates as a subsidiary of Abdullah Ali Almunajem Sons Company.
